caveats: Fixed wall overlay placements are reconstructed exactly from wall Text and wall Sensor objects already present in dungeon.json.
Visible wall texts resolve to the special inscription ornament ordinal used by the original engine.
Wall Sensor.graphic in the export is treated as the original engine OrnamentOrdinal, not as a raw bitmap id.
Multiple fixed variants on the same face are preserved, which is important for stateful overlays such as levers, switches, torch holders, and amalgam states.
Faces marked random-capable are exact candidate locations for decorative random ornaments, but the current export does not yet persist the final resolved pick per face.
This file covers wall faces only. Floor and door ornaments are not included here.
